def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    par_value = 100
    five_year_par_rate = 0.0437
    annual_coupon = par_value * five_year_par_rate
    earlier_spot_rates = [0.025, 0.030, 0.035, 0.040]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    present_value_earlier_coupons = sum(
        annual_coupon / (1 + spot_rate) ** year
        for year, spot_rate in enumerate(earlier_spot_rates, start=1)
    )
    final_cash_flow = par_value + annual_coupon
    five_year_spot_rate = (
        final_cash_flow / (par_value - present_value_earlier_coupons)
    ) ** (1 / 5) - 1
    answer = round(five_year_spot_rate * 100, 3)

    # return answer
    return answer
